name: Premium Ceylon Black Tea
description: Experience the rich, bold flavor of authentic Ceylon black tea, handpicked from the lush estates of Nuwara Eliya. Perfect for a refreshing morning brew.

name: Ceylon Cinnamon Sticks
description: True Ceylon cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum) sticks, known for their delicate, sweet flavor and low coumarin content. Ideal for baking and savory dishes.

name: Organic Ceylon White Tea
description: A rare and exquisite white tea made from unopened buds, sun-dried to perfection. Offers a subtle, delicate flavor with floral notes.

name: Sri Lankan Black Pepper
description: High-quality, aromatic black pepper grown in the tropical climate of Sri Lanka. Adds a robust and spicy kick to any culinary creation.

name: Traditional Wooden Mask
description: A hand-carved, vibrant wooden mask crafted by traditional artisans in Ambalangoda. Represents Sri Lankan folklore and cultural heritage.

name: Handloom Silk Saree
description: An elegant, intricately woven handloom silk saree, blending traditional techniques with contemporary designs. A timeless addition to any wardrobe.

name: Ceylon Moonstone Pendant
description: A beautifully crafted pendant featuring a genuine Ceylon moonstone, known for its captivating blue sheen. Set in high-quality sterling silver.

name: Roasted Cashew Nuts
description: Premium quality cashew nuts, perfectly roasted to bring out their buttery, rich flavor. A healthy and delicious snack.

name: Virgin Coconut Oil
description: 100% pure, cold-pressed virgin coconut oil extracted from fresh Ceylon coconuts. Versatile for cooking, skin care, and hair care.

name: Ceylon Curry Powder Blend
description: An authentic, aromatic blend of roasted spices tailored for traditional Sri Lankan curries. Elevates the flavor profile of meat and vegetable dishes.
